result_summary:
The report is registered in navigation but was never actually built — there's no report model or JRXML for it. I'll delegate to the report-designer to author it per the spec already in the nav entry's functional_specs.The sub-agent authored the report but couldn't run the platform's actual validate/execute self-check (it claimed the tools weren't available). I have those tools myself — let me verify directly.The report engine (pyjasper) isn't installed in this environment, so neither I nor the sub-agent could run the actual JasperReports validate/execute self-check — this matches the sub-agent's own caveat. The model JSON is valid and the JRXML file exists; the SQL was independently verified against live data, but the JRXML XML structure itself is unverified against the JasperReports engine.

**What changed:**
- `Metadata_Model/report_models/model_fam_verification_report.json` (new) — report model with criteria VERIFICATION_CYCLE_NO, BRANCH_CODE, LOCATION_CODE, VERIFICATION_DATE range; default output PDF.
- `Report_Design/fam_verification_report/report.jrxml` (new) — grouped by location, per-status counts + grand total, detail columns (asset code/name, expected location, status found, remarks, verified date), Verifier/Approver signature blocks. Built on `fam_physical_verification` (header) + `fam_physical_verification_line` (detail) + `fam_asset_register` (asset name).

**Caveat:** JRXML XSD-validation and live render could not be run here (pyjasper not installed) — recommend opening the report in the designer/preview to confirm it renders before relying on it in production. No FRS update needed since this restores a nav entry's already-declared spec rather than changing functional scope.
